::: {#exm-word-letters}
#### Words and their letters

The pairs found in @sol-word-letters form a relation (@def-binary-relation) from $W$ to $L$,

$$
H = \set{(\text{cat}, \text{c}), (\text{cat}, \text{t}), (\text{dog}, \text{d}), (\text{dog}, \text{o}), (\text{owl}, \text{o})},
$$

where $w \mathrel{H} x$ means that the word $w$ has the letter $x$.
So $\text{cat} \mathrel{H} \text{t}$,
but $(\text{owl}, \text{t}) \notin H$.
The word cat is related to two letters,
and the letter o has two words related to it.

The empty set and $W \times L$ itself are relations from $W$ to $L$ too:
the first relates no word to any letter,
and the second relates every word to every letter.

:::
